title: Services and customer needs
objectives: Match customer needs to relevant service categories.
explanation: AITS publicly lists CCTV, network cabling, security systems, internet, telephone systems, access control, home automation and solar services. Learn what each category addresses before proposing a product. CCTV supports visual monitoring; access control manages entry; network infrastructure connects devices and services.

A customer request may span several categories. Ask about the problem, location, existing equipment and desired outcome. Record uncertainty instead of promising compatibility, price, installation dates or a service level. A technical survey and approved quotation process are separate from this introductory training.
example: Fictional Lotus Workshop wants to see its entrance remotely and restrict staff-door access. CCTV and access control are relevant; connectivity also needs investigation.
exercise: List three discovery questions for Lotus Workshop without collecting passwords.
model_response: What areas need coverage? Who should be allowed through the door? What network equipment and connection already exist?
